start.about_title:
About {bot} A focused, reliable music player for Telegram group voice chats: fast downloads, a real queue, and controls that stay out of the way.
Playback — audio, video and live streams Queue — ordering, loop, seek and prefetching Speech — 0.5 to 2 playback speed Playlists — save and replay your own sets
Uptime: {uptime} Support: community group Updates: release channel

help.private_intro: Browse a topic to find commands, playback controls, and group setup tips. Need help? Join the Support Group.
help.group_intro: Click the button below to view help.

sections.controls: Playback Controls Manage the music that is already playing in this group. /pause — Pause the current track. /resume — Continue paused playback. /skip — Skip to the next track. Use /skip 2 to skip multiple tracks when supported. /end or /stop — Stop playback and clear the queue. /player — Open the interactive player. /queue — View upcoming tracks. /seek 30 — Jump to a position in seconds. /seekback 15 — Move backward by seconds. /speed or /playback — Adjust playback speed. /loop 1-10 — Repeat the current track. /autoplay — Open smart autoplay settings. Use /autoplay on or /autoplay off to control related-track playback. Some playback actions require group admin or authorized-user permissions, depending on the group settings.
sections.play: Play Music Start audio or video playback in the group's voice chat. /play [song name or URL] — Search for a track or play a supported link. /vplay [song name or URL] — Request video playback. /playforce [song name or URL] — Replace the current stream with your requested track. /vplayforce [song name or URL] — Force video playback. Examples /play A Sky Full of Stars /vplay https://youtu.be/… Add the bot to a group, start a voice chat, and send a play command. Availability depends on the source and track. Saved personal playlists /addpl [name] — Create a playlist and get its short code. /addpl [code] [song or URL] — Add a track to one of your playlists. /playlist — List your saved playlists and their short codes. /playlist [code] — Queue a saved playlist in a group voice chat. Anyone with the code can play it. /delpl [code] — Delete one of your playlists.
sections.admins: Group Admins Commands for managing playback permissions in your group. /auth [username or user_id] — Allow a user to run admin playback commands without being a Telegram group admin. /unauth [username or user_id] — Remove a user's authorization. /authusers — List authorized users. Group settings: • Admin commands — Choose whether playback controls are available to everyone or only admins and authorized users. • Play type — Choose who can start playback. • Search mode — Choose direct playback or inline audio/video selection. /settings — Open group playback settings. Telegram group administrators can change group settings. Bot-owner commands are listed separately.
sections.owners: Bot Owners Maintenance and moderation commands reserved for the bot owner or configured privileged operators. These are not ordinary group-admin commands. /broadcast [message or reply] — Send an announcement to chats served by the bot. /blacklistchat [chat_id] — Block a chat from using the bot. /whitelistchat [chat_id] — Remove a chat from the blacklist. /blacklistedchat — List blacklisted chats. /block [username or reply] — Block a user from using bot commands. /unblock [username or reply] — Restore a blocked user. /blockedusers — List blocked users. /logs — View bot logs. /logger [enable/disable] — Toggle activity logging. /maintenance [enable/disable] — Toggle maintenance mode. Owner-only commands may be unavailable to regular users. Do not share owner credentials or grant privileged access to untrusted users.
